paite: Pilna akikou in, theihsiamna in a-aw asuah kei maw?
heading: Pilna Phatna

paite: Lampi a mun sangte tung ah, lampite kisutna ah adingh a;
kongpite biang ah, khopi lutna ah, kongkhakte apailutna ah, nakpi in akikou hi.
Noute, aw mite, ka sam; huan ka aw mite tapa kiang ah ahi.
Aw nou mimawlte, kivensiamna theisiam un; nou mihaite, lungtang theisiam nei un.
Za un, thil hoihpente gen ding ka hi ngal a; huan ka mukte honna thil dikte ahi ding hi.
Ka kam in thutak gen ding ahi ngal a; gitlouhna ka muk a ding in akihhuai hi.
Ka kam a thute teng diktatna ah a-om; huaite ah bangmah diklou a-om kei hi.
Atheisiam kuapeuh a ding in akichian a, theihna mu amaute a ding in adik hi.
Ka hilhna sang unla, dangka hilou in; dangka-eng hoihpen sang in theihna.
Rubi suang sang in pilna ahoihzaw hi; huan deihhuai thilte tengteng huai toh tehpih theih ahi kei uh.
Kei, pilna, kivensiamna toh ka tengkhawm a, theihna leh theihkakna ka mu hi.
TOUPA kihtak a gilou huat ding ahi; kisaktheihna leh, ki-otsakna, gilou lampi leh kam hoih lou, ka hua hi.
Thupha kei a ahi, theihna hoih; theihsiamna leh hatna ka nei hi.
Kei ziak in kumpipate'n vai ahawm ua, lalte'n dikna thu apia uh.
Kei ziak in lalte'n vai ahawm ua, miliante leh lei a vaihawmte tengteng in.
Kei hon itte amau ka it a; kuapeuh hon zong in hon mu hi.
Hauhna leh zahna ka kiang ah a-om; ahi, sawt daih hauhna leh diktatna toh.
Ka gah dangka-eng sang in ahoihzaw, ahi, dangka-eng hoih sang in; ka sum muhna dangka hoihpen sang in.
Diktatna lampi ka zui a, vaihawmna lampite lak ah.
Kei hon itte van ka luahsak theih a, agoubawm uh ka dimsak theihna ding in.
Toupa'n alampi kipat tung in ahon nei a, nidang a athilhihte ma in.
Tangtawn a kipan, atung a kipan leh lei om ma a pan koihkip ka hi.
Thuknate a-om louh lai in, lakkhiak in ka om a; luikhuk tui a dimte a-om louh lai un.
Tangte a-omkip ma a, mualte om ma in lakkhiak in ka om.
Lei leh gam bawlkhiak ahih ma in, leivui a khovel abawl nai louh lai in.
Vante ahihkip lai in, huai ah ka om; tui thuk maikaih a tehna akoih lai in.
Tung a vante abawlkip lai in; tui thukte tuikhukte ahong hat lai un.
Tuipi kiang a agi apiak lai in, huchi a tuite'n athupiak tung a atatleklouhna ding un; lei suangphumte achiamteh lai in.
Huai lai in akiang ah ka om, nasemmi heutu bang in; huan niteng in akipahna ka hi a, ama a kipak gige in;
atentheihna lei ah; ka kipahna mite tapate kiang ah a-om hi.
Huaiziak in tu in, ka tapate, hon ngaikhia unla; ka lampite zui mite'n nuam asa ngal ua.
Hilhna za in pil unla, nial kei un.
Mi kei hon za in nuam asa hi, niteng a ka kongpi leh ka kongkhak khuamte a ngak in.
Kuapeuh hon mu in hinna amu ua, TOUPA deihsakna tang ding ahi uhi.
Himahleh kuapeuh ka tung a thil hihkhial in amah kha ahihdik kei hi; kei hon hote'n sihna a-it uhi.
